regime_context: The detector shows a defensive, healthcare-heavy leadership stack (Big Pharma headline, eligible and crowded; Health Care EW and Consumer Staples EW also eligible/crowded) while the top momentum rank (Memory/HBM) is NOT eligible and has zero breadth, so it is a focus lens only. Momentum rank-IC is ~0 and rotation timing has no forward edge; the only validated leg here is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), and the backtest verdict frames everything as discipline-not-prediction. Given track_record dir_accuracy of 0.413 on n=138, I default to low conviction throughout.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Memory/HBM (currently rank 1, score 1.712, but eligible=false and breadth=0.0) regains eligibility and breadth above ~0.3 — the condition that would retire this watch is SMH regaining eligibility with breadth >0.3 and taking over the headline slot from Big Pharma.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline and the highest-ranked ELIGIBLE scorable theme. It passes the only validated leg (absolute-trend gate: eligible=true, durability_bar 0.84, hurst trend) and shows full breadth (1.0), which is the strongest staying-power signal in the stack. Crowding is high (1.46, crowded=true), which is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
theses.dissent: It is crowded and high in the durability bar — a crowded leader with the highest momentum score for an eligible theme can mean the easy part of the move is over, and health-care leadership can roll over quickly on a single policy headline.

falsifier.text: PPH lags SPY by 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date, or Big Pharma's eligibility flips to false.

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care EW is eligible, trending, with strong breadth (0.917) and durability (0.78). It corroborates the Big Pharma read and offers a broader healthcare exposure through a scorable proxy (XLV). Crowding is high (1.54), again a caution.
theses.dissent: Its score is already behind Big Pharma and it is equally crowded; if healthcare leadership is a late-cycle defensive bid, equal-weight breadth can decay faster than the headline name.

falsifier.text: XLV lags SPY by 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date, or Health Care EW loses eligibility.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Consumer Staples EW is eligible, trending, with high durability (0.80) and strong breadth (0.879). It is part of the same defensive leadership cluster and passes the trend gate. Most crowded in the eligible set (1.89), so this is a small, patient lean at most.
theses.dissent: The crowding flag is at the extreme end of the eligible set; staples leadership at peak crowding often marks a defensive top, and proxy XLP overlaps with the unscorable Defensives theme.

falsifier.text: XLP lags SPY by 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date, or Consumer Staples EW loses eligibility.
